status: NOT MEASURABLE AS DEFINED: the withheld set is empty on every cell (see `finding`), so no standard error exists and the gate cannot be evaluated. This is a result about the endpoint, not a bug in the probe.

finding.statement: an absence-based withheld set is empty on every cell: the formation window already exhibits every ordered tag-pair transition the behavioural window uses, because the world's vocabulary is small and a few hundred cycles of twelve events saturate the pair space. `held_out_next_tag` therefore cannot be defined by absence on this stream. It needs a world that DECLARES a withheld set and enforces it by conditioned sampling, as the compositional family does.

what_this_is: The per-world standard error of `held_out_next_tag`, the Stage B outcome redefined on the scale-stream family (option A), measured by a cluster bootstrap over scored behavioural-test positions for three consumed design-block seeds in each claimed configuration.
why_it_exists: protocol §5a: the predictor `DI` is defined only in the scale-stream family and the former outcome only in the compositional family. Option A keeps the predictor and defines the outcome on the stream the predictor lives on.

endpoint.name: held_out_next_tag
endpoint.scorer: benchmarks.acquisition_compositional.score -- mean pairwise binary log loss, the same scorer the composed endpoint used
endpoint.scored: consecutive-event positions in the behavioural test window that carry an ordered tag transition never seen in formation
endpoint.window: learning 50 cycles then test 50 cycles, starting one cycle after the world's confirmed onset

method: each scored position is a cluster; its cells move together because the vocabulary is scored under every position; the world's score is the ratio (sum of position losses) / (sum of position cell counts), bootstrapped by resampling positions with replacement
cells_are: consumed Phase L seeds, regenerated deterministically; no seed is spent and none is re-allocated
confirmation_cycles_are: the protocol §2 medians per configuration, used to position the behavioural window; no onset is measured here and none is inferred

limits: the two readouts bracket plausible prediction quality (the world's own law and the same machinery rotated onto a wrong law); neither is the engine's readout, whose loss distribution does not exist before the run
the confirmation cycles are the protocol's medians, not measured onsets, so this measures the estimator on plausible windows rather than reproducing a run
the readouts carry no noise beyond the world's own, so a real readout with heavier-tailed losses would give a larger standard error
three design-block seeds per configuration measure the estimator; they do not authorise the run and they are not the confirmatory block
a bootstrap standard deviation is itself estimated, so the reported figures carry Monte-Carlo uncertainty not shown here
